versions.changelog:
ai-video-cinematography 1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive AI video cinematography guide in Chinese and English.
- Covers camera movement techniques, emotional expression mapping, and prompts for skin realism.
- Includes detailed tables mapping film emotions to professional camera terms and AI prompt words.
- Provides practical guidance for working with leading AI video generation tools (Kling, Runway, Luma, etc.).
- Features best practices for crafting prompts and includes negative keywords to enhance skin authenticity.
- Contains real-world prompt case studies for immediate application.
